description: A shared named formula has an accepted finite derivation code from a given finite context exactly when the corpus natural-deduction calculus derives it from that context.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.checked_sequent_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (Γ : List (L.Formula ℕ)) (a : L.Formula ℕ) :
  (∃ d,
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.Der S d (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.contextCode S Γ)
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.namedCode S a)) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof L Γ.toFinset a
